title: Session: 2.13.0 launch policy on DevBot
objective: Validate version 2.13.0 on schema 005: the role-layout switch, the multi-character union with onboarding-independent registered Guest, closed guest applications, officer grants before binding, and the deployment-guard refusals, while keeping DevBot's existing roles, layout and access.
user: Deploy 2.13.0: stopped-writer backup, restore rehearsal with `migrate.js --restore-rehearsal`, migration 005, guild command registration.
Run `/config show` and `/config validate`; role layout should read on.
As a non-manager officer, try `/config role_layout enabled:false` (refused); as owner, turn it off, `/refresh`, confirm roles keep order, then turn it back on.
With `/assign` (numeric IDs), link an FC and a non-FC character to one test user (Member only), then unassign the FC one (Guest).
`/config guest_applications clear:true`, then `/apply` as a visitor: refused before the form opens.
`/guest revoke` then `/guest grant` the test user; revocation must survive `/refresh`.
assistant: Verify schema 005 rows (layout on, grandfather marker empty), command inventory via `commands.js list`, and startup layout convergence.
Confirm guard refusals: `register.js --global`, and `preview.js`/`activate.js` for the production guild under the DevBot env.
Record backup, migration time, job and audit IDs, and readbacks.
bot: Run compiled version 2.13.0 behind the single-writer database lease on schema 005.
Grant Guest to linked non-FC users in every guild and Member for any FC character; gate role layout per guild.
Refuse /apply before the modal when applications are closed; keep channel visibility tied to onboarding.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in the configured development channel.
